propositions: On the agentic path, message history accumulates and is re-sent uncached every turn, causing input cost to grow O(N^2) in the number of turns.

The current cache_settings_for implementation sets only anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions, leaving anthropic_cache and anthropic_cache_messages unused for agentic multi-turn scenarios.
The cache ineffectiveness is invisible to telemetry because the system block hits cache, making cache_read_tokens nonzero and preventing the warn_if_cache_ineffective predicate from firing.
Anthropic and Bedrock providers require different cache control keys: Bedrock rejects top-level cache_control and requires bedrock_cache_messages instead of anthropic_cache.
Single-turn paths must remain byte-identical to avoid regression when adding message-tail caching to the agentic path only.
